name: Linkwarden
description: Self-hosted bookmark manager, read-it-later, and web archiving tool.

ram_rec_mb.quote: Linkwarden has pretty minimal hardware requirements - it was tested on a VPS with 4gb of memory and it ran pretty smoothly, the most intense part is when you build the app, but once it's running it's relatively lightweight.
ram_rec_mb.scope: Docker Compose install, general — informal figure from official docs (a tested-on report, not a stated min/rec spec); building the app is noted as the heaviest phase

no_official_figure.note: Only the anecdotal 4GB figure above is published (as ram_rec_mb); no formal minimum RAM and no CPU core-count figure exists anywhere in official docs.
